change: Lazily build one source-file lookup per Expand project request. Every map retains its original complete validation and logical source/entry charges.
invariants: SourceMapValidator binds one immutable source slice. Its fields are private; construction performs no validation, allocation or budget work. SourceMap::validate remains available and constructs a temporary validator.
Cold scans still subtract one step immediately before each source insertion and duplicate check. A duplicate can precede a later budget failure; any incomplete scan leaves no cached table.
A successful complete source scan may be retained after an entry error. Unique immutable source identities make a later bulk checked_sub(sources.len()) observationally equivalent to the old scan.

Each call independently checks map/source max_nodes, initializes remaining from the current limits, creates targets and runs entry identity/parent, unique target, origin/related/generated UTF-8/span checks in the original order.

Project integration replaces only the source argument to the internal expander with the request validator. The actual validation call remains after e.diagnostics rejection; cumulative project map work/node accounting is unchanged.
Standalone APIs still bind just their own source; no cross-request caching, validation result, trusted capability, schema or IR change.
